description.value: Lighthouse Bistro & Pub is a waterfront restaurant on Nanaimo's harbourfront serving West Coast cuisine — fresh halibut, salmon, tuna poke, chowder, gourmet burgers, and craft drinks from Vancouver Island producers. The scenic outdoor patio overlooks Nanaimo Harbour and the restaurant sits close to the ferry terminal and seaplane dock, making it a natural stop for cyclists arriving or departing the island. Walk-ins are welcomed for groups under six.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 27m; stands (3 spaces) at 46m; stands (2 spaces) at 77m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is full and detailed, confirming the business is real, open, and operating at 50 Anchor Way, Nanaimo. The website explicitly confirms takeout and online ordering, and vegetarian/gluten-friendly menu options. A postal code discrepancy exists between OSM (V9R 5H9) and the website footer (V9R 7B5); the website also provides a phone number (250-754-3212) absent from OSM. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere in the website content.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active waterfront restaurant with a live website, confirmed menu, and public access. Useful to touring cyclists as a meal stop near the Nanaimo ferry terminal.
